versions.changelog:
Initial release of the cost-estimation skill.

- Provides cost estimation for architecture designs across compute, cloud services, bandwidth, storage, and more.
- Inputs: architecture design and risk assessment; Outputs: detailed cost estimation report with breakdowns, comparisons, and forecasts.
- Includes methods for scale-based and usage-based estimation, referencing real-time pricing from major cloud and AI providers.
- Supports multi-solution cost comparison, cost driver sensitivity analysis, and optimization recommendations.
- Offers a comprehensive reporting template and a checklist to ensure thorough coverage of all cost aspects.
